## Où j'en suis
The real replay into `events.replay.v3` has completed successfully, producing 18,442,107 events. The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 is currently running (~61% progress after 55 minutes). Count verification and incident closure are pending backfill completion. PR #233 is merged, PR #241 is explicitly set aside. (source: ses-rp-2, ses-rp-1)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 is running; waiting for completion to compare ClickHouse row counts against historical baselines. (source: ses-rp-2)
- [prochaine-étape] Verify that aggregated counts match within tolerance, then officially close the incident. Align with Rachel on customer communications regarding the Thursday restore window. (source: ses-rp-2)
- [essai-raté] Initial dry run failed with an OOMKilled error due to the strict 2Gi memory cap with 50k batches; switching to 5k batches resolved the issue and kept usage within quota. (source: r1-03, r1-04)
- [décision] All events must be replayed exclusively into `events.replay.v3`, never directly into `events.v3`. Daniel alone handles the dedup key CI fix, so PR #241 is ignored. The incident remains open until counts are fully verified. (source: r1-02, r2-07, r2-09)
